title: Fate/Grand Order -Epic of Remnant- SE,RA.PH
description: The advanced AI BB seizes Chaldea without warning and announces that a new Singularity has appeared in the year 2030. Fujimaru Ritsuka, humanity’s last Master, chooses a Rayshift into the future—and it is BB’s trap, of course. Waiting at the far end is the oldest Holy Grail War, and the newest: one hundred twenty-eight pairs of Masters and Servants fighting until only one remains, a battlefield with no exit. In that hell modeled on the Moon Cell’s Grail War, a story of new hope and new bonds is spun.
author: Type-Moon
